items.text: Attention producers: one month from today, March 15, is the last day to enroll in USDA’s Agriculture Risk Coverage and Price Loss Coverage programs for 2022. Find more information below. https://t.co/BeQeKIq9oI

.@USDA and the Biden-Harris Administration are working to deliver results for women across the country by dismantling the barriers they face in the workplace. A competitive economy for the future includes full participation and fair treatment in the workforce. #EqualPayDay
I tested positive for COVID. I’m both vaccinated and boosted and thankfully my symptoms are mild. If you have yet to get vaccinated and boosted, please don’t wait.

Today I'm announcing $131 million for wildfire reduction treatment thanks to @POTUS’s Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. @USDA is taking the next step in reducing wildfire risk, especially in western states where communities, infrastructure and resources are at the most risk.

Today I announced the first round of funding for @usdaRD's Emergency Rural Health Care Grants. Funded by @POTUS's American Rescue Plan, the $43 million announced today will help rural hospitals and local communities broaden access to essential health care services.
Expanding access to healthcare via telehealth.

The Inflation Reduction Act helps families save on prescription drugs & health premiums and supports farmers, ranchers, and forest landowners competing in a global economy with climate smart investments. @POTUS promised to lower costs for regular families. This bill does that.

Complimentary food systems allow farmers to have access to commercial and local markets. The ability to sell to local schools, hospitals, and grocery stores create relationships that provide opportunity for small businesses to take root again in rural places. https://t.co/OjvImdcw4V

Today @USDA is hosting the National Summit on Nutrition Security and Healthcare as a direct follow-up to last month’s @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health. #foodismedicine #nutritionsecurity https://t.co/v5oep0vaeq

Yesterday, @USDA hosted the national Nutrition Security and Healthcare Summit. It was a great event, and I was energized to see the momentum from the @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health continues. https://t.co/YsPhvH37IQ

Last week, @POTUS released the President’s Budget for FY24, building on his historic progress for working Americans by:  

👪  Lowering costs for families  
🛡️  Protecting and strengthening Medicare & Social Security  
🏗️  Investing in American manufacturing & innovation

I joined @SecCardona in sending a letter to higher ed leaders, including those based in land-grant institutions, with important information to help connect students & their families to affordable health coverage through Medicaid, CHIP & ACA. Learn more: https://t.co/M0w40LnMTa

Access to high-quality healthcare is a basic necessity for every community. Through @USDA's Emergency Rural Health Care Grants program, we're working to ensure that rural communities receive the healthcare they need & deserve, regardless of their zip code.https://t.co/sUgEJQFGLr

I’m sorry to hear about @CongressmanGT’s cancer diagnosis. Having worked alongside GT, I know he is a fighter for rural America and Pennsylvanians, and I’m confident he will overcome this battle and be cancer free soon. Christie and I will be praying for a quick recovery.
We’re modernizing and improving access to critical nutrition assistance programs, like SNAP and WIC, to support optimal health and well-being.

American farmers, growers, biobased business owners and innovators are resilient and thriving. We are committed to celebrating them and the economic, environmental and health benefits of biobased products on National Biobased Products Day. https://t.co/VMZ5iFCGDI

The Biden-Harris Administration understands that private landowners are key in the fight for climate resilience & forest health. Today, we're investing nearly $145M in this first round from @POTUS' Inflation Reduction Act to connect forest landowners with emerging climate markets

The work that @ClearLakeCSD is doing to improve the nutritional quality of school meals, support local producers, and engage its students through hands-on programming exemplifies the comprehensive approach to health and wellbeing of the Healthy Meals Incentive Initiative. https://t.co/1EVbY3xMjf

Our veterinary teams at @USDA_APHIS, and federal and state veterinary and public health partners, are actively monitoring the detection of HPAI in four TX and KS dairy herds. Based on findings from Texas, the detections appear to have been introduced by wild birds.

We are encouraging farmers to follow biosecurity practices and to report symptoms to their state veterinarians. Milk from affected cows has been diverted from the market, and pasteurization also kills viruses in milk.

Today, @USDANutrition announced science-driven enhancements to the foods prescribed to participants in the WIC program, a major step forward in promoting nutrition security and maternal and child health. https://t.co/Dqhk65ix0U

These participant-centered changes will strengthen WIC by ensuring the foods participants receive reflect the latest nutrition science to support healthy eating and the brightest futures. https://t.co/xqGmxyLAHh

This week, @USDANutrition announced revisions to the WIC package, since then this announcement has been met with overwhelming support & applause from nutrition leaders, moms, & leading health organizations across the country. See what they're saying here ⬇️https://t.co/qxcw9eo7Fe

Astronauts going to space deserve access to a safe, healthy food supply. That's why, @USDA_ARS and @NASA are developing a hyperspectral imaging system to monitor plant health in growth chambers, so astronauts can have fresh crops to eat during future space missions.

It was a pleasure to attend and speak at the 2024 @AmerAcadPeds Advocacy Conference on Monday. We need to put infant, child, and maternal health at the center—no one can do that better than pediatricians. https://t.co/5kYkxR0Zw8
